WITH color_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    p.product_color,
    AVG(ili.derived_product_cost) as color_avg
  FROM Products p
  JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
  WHERE p.product_color IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.product_color
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(color_avg) as overall_average
  FROM color_stats
),
kept_colors AS (
  SELECT 
    cs.product_color,
    cs.color_avg
  FROM color_stats cs
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE cs.color_avg > oa.overall_average
),
kept_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(color_avg) as kept_colors_average
  FROM kept_colors
)
SELECT 
  kc.product_color,
  kc.color_avg,
  kc.color_avg - oa.overall_average,
  kc.color_avg - ka.kept_colors_average
FROM kept_colors kc
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
CROSS JOIN kept_avg ka
WHERE kc.color_avg > ka.kept_colors_average
ORDER BY kc.product_color
